    Plot one-vs-rest rhythmic marker heatmap

    plot_ovr_heatmap.Rd

    This function builds a full-matrix heatmap for one-vs-rest target rhythmic markers across multiple cell types. Genes are grouped by their target cell type and ordered by target-group peak phase. Columns are grouped by cell type and smoothed along inferred cell phase.

    plot_ovr_heatmap(
  count,
  res_phase,
  ovr_result,
  metadata,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  scale_factor = 10000,
  palette = NULL,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    count

    A gene-by-cell count matrix. Row names must be gene names and column names must be cell names.

    res_phase

    A data.frame returned by infer_cell_phase(). It must contain "cell" and the column specified by theta_by.

    ovr_result

    A data.frame returned by infer_ovr_rhythm(), usually res_ovr$ovr_result. It must contain "gene", "TargetCellType", "Phase_group1", and "target_specific_flag".

    metadata

    A data.frame containing cell-level metadata. Cells are matched to count by the cell column if available, otherwise by row names.

    celltype_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata used for cell-type groups. Defaults to "celltype".

    theta_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in res_phase containing inferred cell phase in radians. Defaults to "theta_pred".

    scale_factor

    A numeric value passed to Seurat::NormalizeData(). Defaults to 10000.

    palette

    A named list specifying optional palettes for celltype, phase, and heatmap. If NULL, default scRhythmBayes palettes are used. Defaults to NULL.

    Verbose

    Logical; if TRUE, progress messages are printed. Defaults to FALSE.

    Value

    An object of class scRhythmOVRHeatmap.

    Details

    This function accepts a gene-by-cell count matrix and uses Seurat internally for log-normalization and scaling. Users do not need to provide a Seurat object.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

res_param <- infer_gene_param(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred,
  r_cell = res_phase$r_cell,
  strata_by = "celltype",
  B = 5,
  n_worker = 1,
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

res_ovr <- infer_ovr_rhythm(
  param_long = res_param$param_long,
  group_by = "celltype",
  Verbose = FALSE
)

ht_ovr <- plot_ovr_heatmap(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  res_phase = res_phase,
  ovr_result = res_ovr$ovr_result,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  celltype_by = "celltype"
)

ht_ovr
plot(ht_ovr)
} # }
